text: Figure 12.86: Modeling of the GenericDiagnosticTransportInstantiation [TPS_MANI_03335] Semantics of GenericDiagnosticTransportInstanti- ation ⌈Meta-class GenericDiagnosticTransportInstantiation represents the ability to configure a generic diagnostic transport protocol (other than DoIP) used to define the communication of diagnostic testers with the vehicle. ⌋ The configuration of DoIp is described in Chapter 12.5. Class GenericDiagnosticTransportInstantiation Note This meta-class defines a generic transport protocol (other than DoIP) for communication of diagnostic testers with a vehicle. Please note that the necessary configuration attributes can be defined via Special Data Groups. This Class is only used by the AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform.
